name: Aslan Shiguang Lu
source:
The game is set in a world called Continent of Aslan, where humans and beastmen coexist with the modern life.

Hundreds of years ago, the two races started a century-long war for the ownership of the material resources. A hundred years later, the two warring parties signed a peace treaty, and thus, Continent of Aslan has ushered in the era of peace.

However, if there are those who are sincerely willing to live in peace between the two races, there will naturally be those who oppose it.

The two ethnic groups who were willing to live together peacefully, called 'Reformists', occupied the eastern and southern parts of the continent and established a symbiosis zone.

The opponents of symbiosis is known as the 'Conservatives', The "Conservatives" in the human kind have returned to the western part of the continent where they have lived for generations.

The protagonist, Samuel, is a human from the western part of Continent of Aslan, and it is well known that everyone there hate beastmen. However, he doesn't share the same mindset.

Due to some reasons, he came to the eastern part of the continent to go to college. What would he encounter there?

[Translated from [url=https://samuelq.itch.io/aslan-time]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在亚斯兰大陆。在这里，人类与兽人共同生活于现代社会。

数百年前，两族为争夺物质资源而爆发了持续百年的战争。一百年后，交战双方签订和平条约，亚斯兰大陆由此迎来和平时代。

然而，既然有人真心希望两族和平共处，自然也有人反对。

愿意和平共处的两族群体被称为“改革派”。他们占据大陆东部和南部，并建立了共生区。

反对共生的人则被称为“保守派”。人类中的保守派已经返回世代居住的大陆西部。

主角Samuel是来自亚斯兰大陆西部的人类。众所周知，那里的所有人都憎恨兽人，但他并不认同这种想法。

由于某些原因，他来到大陆东部上大学。在那里他会遇到什么？
